proposed_change.summary: Two canonical statements about storefront page-load behaviour become misleading once TIB-5460 ships. BOTH SIDES are retained; nothing is corrected here.

side_canonical.claim: SDK localStorage is created lazily on first personalization interaction, and the enumerated keys are the two personalization draft keys.
Page load issues campaigns/{id}.json plus the SDK bootstrap scripts; thumbmark is relegated to payload.unmapped_evidence as an unexplained extra.

side_task.source: JIRA:TIB-5460 comment 51220 item 2 and 'Before you start'
side_task.claim: The SDK fetches the visitor ID at page load and caches it in localStorage under a THIRD key, teeinblue_signed_thumbmark, with no expiry - before any personalization interaction. Thumbmark becomes a deliberate, retried, 8s-timeout page-load request, i.e. first-class page-load behaviour.
